title: Skeleton imports
goal: Every module under src/main/org/apache/commons/cli imports cleanly with signatures intact (bodies may still be `pass`); build_check passes.

title: Leaf utilities & base exception
goal: Implement Util (stripLeadingHyphens/stripLeadingAndTrailingQuotes and any other static helpers), OptionValidator (option-character validation), and ParseException (base exception class with message).

title: Exception hierarchy built on ParseException
goal: Implement UnrecognizedOptionException, AmbiguousOptionException, MissingArgumentException, MissingOptionException, each subclassing ParseException with faithful message formatting and stored option references.

title: Option and nested Builder
goal: Implement Option.py fully, including the nested Builder class, argument/value storage, type conversion hooks, and equals/hashCode/toString semantics; depends on OptionValidator.

title: OptionGroup & AlreadySelectedException
goal: Implement OptionGroup (selected/required option tracking) and AlreadySelectedException, reproducing exact selection-conflict behavior and messages; depends on Option.

title: Options container
goal: Implement Options.py: add/get option and group management, short/long option maps, required-options tracking; depends on Option, OptionGroup, Util.

title: Pattern/Type conversion
goal: Implement PatternOptionBuilder and TypeHandler with faithful conversion results and ParseException messages on failure, including createDate/createFiles permanently raising; depends on Option, Options, ParseException.

title: CommandLine and nested Builder
goal: Implement CommandLine.py including the nested Builder, option/value storage and retrieval, and typed getters via TypeHandler; depends on Option, ParseException, TypeHandler, Util.

title: CommandLineParser interface & legacy Parser family
goal: Implement CommandLineParser (interface), Parser (abstract base with shared parsing logic), BasicParser, GnuParser, PosixParser, reproducing exact CommandLine.options/args ordering and exception types/messages for malformed input.

title: DefaultParser and nested Builder
goal: Implement DefaultParser.py including the nested Builder, the modern parsing algorithm covering ambiguous/long-option/partial-match handling; depends on everything through M7 plus AmbiguousOptionException.

title: OptionBuilder (deprecated static builder)
goal: Implement OptionBuilder.py's static fluent-builder methods for constructing Option instances, matching Java's deprecated static API surface; depends on Option.

title: HelpFormatter and nested OptionComparator
goal: Implement HelpFormatter.py including the nested OptionComparator, reproducing exact printed usage/help text (line-wrapping, padding widths, prefixes/separators, newline characters) written to the passed writer; depends on Options, OptionGroup, Option.

title: Golden conformance
goal: All 21 classes in org.apache.commons.cli are fully translated with no pass/.../TODO/NotImplementedError bodies remaining; the entire suite passes, confirming full behavioral parity with the Java source.

title: Retry deferred tests
goal: Fix and re-enable the previously-skipped tests so they pass: ["OptionGroupTest::testValidLongOnlyOptions", "OptionGroupTest::testTwoValidOptions", "OptionGroupTest::testTwoValidLongOptions", "OptionGroupTest::testTwoOptionsFromGroupWithProperties", "OptionGroupTest::testTwoOptionsFromGroup", "OptionGroupTest::testTwoOptionsFromDifferentGroup", "OptionGroupTest::testTwoLongOptionsFromGroup", "OptionGroupTest::testSingleOptionFromGroup", "OptionGroupTest::testSingleOption", "OptionGroupTest::testSingleLongOption", "OptionGroupTest::testNoOptionsExtraArgs", "OptionGroupTest::testGetNames"]. Implement the functionality they exercise; they are re-enabled in this milestone's gate. If they still cannot pass, they are skipped permanently.
